instruction:
Repair this interrupted project and extend it into a chain-backed, economically coordinated self-improving graph system.

First reproduce and fix the real current failure: project.fractal says executing, run-state says interrupted, node reproduce was released after tool_failure and budget_exceeded retries, and failures are unresolved, while `fractal projects` labels project 42 complete/idle and `fractal resume 42` says nothing to resume. Make canonical durable graph state authoritative; make status/resume agree and safely recover without manual graph edits.

Integrate existing Fractal chain/Life economy primitives from /workspace/fractalmaster and /workspace/fractalchain as an optional chain-authoritative coordination and settlement layer:

- Measure verified graph work, held-out benchmark gains, useful reusable artifacts, compute/storage, and accepted repairs as production.
- Use signed leases/receipts; anchor evidence and benchmark identities; settle only after independent verification and replay-safe finality.
- Allocate bounded capital among strategies, workers, graph expansions, verifiers, and experiments through task budgets/auctions, risk-adjusted expected value, opportunity cost, exploration budgets, and portfolio limits.
- Use integer accounting, conservation invariants, exposure/drawdown limits, circuit breakers, and vesting/clawbacks for later regressions. Never mint rewards from self-reported scores.
- Reward net held-out improvement under matched budgets. Penalize regressions, duplicates, dependency violations, stranded tasks, unverifiable claims, excess cost/latency, collusion, wash activity, sybils, verifier conflicts, and reward hacking.
- Reputation means delayed evidence-weighted predictive accuracy. Separate proposer, worker, verifier, and allocator roles; use independent conflict-free committees for high-value settlements.
- Fail closed when chain is offline: retain signed local receipts in an idempotent outbox, claim no final settlement, never substitute a simulator for production evidence, and reconcile exactly once after recovery.
- Add deterministic adversarial market simulations: honest competition, concentration/monopoly, collusion, sybil floods, verifier capture, manipulation, adverse selection, moral hazard, replay/reorg, and boom/bust budgets.
- Compare economic scheduling with FIFO, current heuristics, and non-economic adaptive scheduling under identical graph/model/token/time/action/cost budgets. Measure quality-adjusted throughput, latency/recovery, verifier accuracy, capital efficiency, regret, concentration, insolvency/default, reward leakage, duplicate work, and held-out gain.
- Correctness, dependency safety, and evidence gates are hard constraints, never purchasable tradeoffs.
- Provide one repeatable local/CI benchmark command, canonical JSON, human capital-markets report, justified regression gates, rollback, and health states distinguishing source-present, devnet-live, chain-authoritative, degraded-outbox, and finalized.
- Reuse existing chain_economics, signed receipt, emission, settlement, and Life devnet components; do not create a toy token or duplicate ledger.

Create parallel-safe recovery, chain integration, mechanism design, adversarial simulation, benchmark, observability, and verification lanes. Preserve unrelated changes. Benchmark every claimed improvement and report neutral or negative outcomes honestly.
